slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: IT support in Bradford: your questions

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: Do you have an office in Bradford?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: No. Our offices are at 124 City Rd in London and Caxton Point in Stevenage, and we are straight about that rather than listing a virtual address. Bradford is covered by our UK service desk plus a team of field engineers who travel to customer sites. In practice most issues never need a visit at all: we respond the same working day and resolve most issues remotely. When a site visit is requested, we aim to have an engineer with you the same working day.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: We are a small team. Is managed IT overkill for us?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Usually not, and small teams often feel the benefit soonest, because there is no one internally to absorb an IT problem. The scope is matched to the size of the business, so you are not paying for enterprise processes you will never touch.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Yes. The office side is straightforward; the interesting parts are shared and shop-floor devices, machines running software that cannot be patched on a normal schedule, and making sure a production stoppage is treated as the priority it actually is.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Faults are graded P1 to P5, each with its own SLA. A P1 is reserved for something that stops the whole business, an internet outage or a failed server, and gets immediate attention. Lower priorities still carry a committed response time, so nothing sits in a queue unacknowledged.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: We start with an assessment of your current systems and what the business actually needs, agree a support plan, deploy the tooling we use for remote assistance, monitoring and patching, then go live. You get a named point of contact rather than a ticket portal and nothing else.
